verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key and authenticator, covering FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP and PIV, plus the nitropy CLI for managing the device. A user-defined engine of event-triggered automation rules is a workflow-platform capability, not something security keys of this kind ship, so this story is the wrong axis. Nothing in the evidence shows such a rule engine; touch confirmation and PAM login are fixed authentication behaviours, not user-defined rules.
